description: This file implements SPNEGO (Negotiate) authentication mechanisms using GSS-API in curl, including functions for encoding, decoding, and managing SPNEGO tokens and state during authentication.

methods.name: bool Curl_auth_is_spnego_supported(void)
methods.description: Checks if SPNEGO (Negotiate) authentication is supported by the GSS-API library.

methods.name: CURLcode Curl_auth_decode_spnego_message(struct Curl_easy * data,const char * user,const char * password,const char * service,const char * host,const char * chlg64,struct negotiatedata * nego)
methods.description: Decodes a base64-encoded SPNEGO challenge message and generates a security context response.

methods.name: CURLcode Curl_auth_create_spnego_message(struct negotiatedata * nego,char ** outptr,size_t * outlen)
methods.description: Encodes the generated SPNEGO security token into base64 for sending.

methods.name: void Curl_auth_cleanup_spnego(struct negotiatedata * nego)
methods.description: Cleans up and releases resources associated with SPNEGO authentication context.

ctags.name: Curl_auth_decode_spnego_message
ctags.signature: (struct Curl_easy * data,const char * user,const char * password,const char * service,const char * host,const char * chlg64,struct negotiatedata * nego)
